business_problem: unify connected-product, warranty, logistics, and customer data so service teams and engineers could act on reliable appliance insight instead of disconnected systems.
solution_summary: Sub-Zero uses Snowflake in Azure as an enterprise data platform for connected appliances, warranty operations, and logistics analytics. Diagnostic signals from millions of appliances, with more than 200 sensors in a single refrigerator or dishwasher, are centralized in Snowflake alongside customer care, warranty, sales, supply-chain, and distribution data so teams can work from one governed view. Customer care agents use device-level diagnostics to troubleshoot issues over the phone, service teams predict required parts before dispatching trucks, and engineering teams analyze real usage patterns to improve future product designs. By keeping semi-structured product data and business data together on Snowflake, Sub-Zero shifted from siloed reporting to proactive service, smarter logistics, and more informed product innovation.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Centralizes connected-product, customer-care, warranty, and operational data for service and engineering analytics.

data_flow: Sensor and diagnostic data from connected appliances is centralized in Snowflake with warranty, customer-care, sales, and supply-chain data. Curated views are then used by service agents, field technicians, logistics planners, and engineers to troubleshoot, predict parts, and improve product design.
business_outcome: Sub-Zero reduced service incidents by 11%, cut warranty-related inefficiencies, improved proactive customer support, and gave engineering and logistics teams a stronger data foundation for product and route decisions.
